meaning: This connection puts the hydrostatic element Hs_Pa in series between the arterial pressure source Pa and the brain inlet, so cerebral inflow pressure carries a posture-dependent gravitational offset. It fixes where the arterial hydrostatic column enters the topology.

could_move.what: Inlet pressure seen by the brain compartment, and hence cerebral inflow, in tilted postures
Postural-change results that depend on the arterial-side gravitational offset
Cross-model comparison, if m4 places its arterial hydrostatic term elsewhere
Baseline steady state, unless the offset is exactly zero at the reference posture
Bistability basins, which sit on top of this operating point

expectation: Unknown in sign and size from the code alone. It scales with the height and tilt angle given to Hs_Pa; at zero tilt it may be near zero, but I cannot confirm that here.

check.why: Re-solves and replots one deck only, so a shifted arterial inlet pressure or a broken connection shows up without a full re-fit.
